title: TangleClaw Canonical Sprint Report Metrics Schema (Rule #283.5 / P4 v2.0)
description: Authoritative machine-readable schema defining all timing, work-completion, code-diff, operating-cost, orthogonal efficiency, and legacy ADE_v1 metrics across TangleClaw sprint and retrospective reports.

metrics.name: First Sprint Activity / Gate 0 or Pipelined Dispatch Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Earliest recorded sprint authorization (OP-GO / Gate 0 co-sign) or pipelined Guardrail 06 builder dispatch timestamp for the release.
metrics.source_of_truth: Sprint Charter Gate 0 receipt / SQLite bridge_audit & medusa_messages

metrics.name: Earliest Feature Branch Commit Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Earliest git author/committer timestamp on the second-parent lineage (sha^1..sha^2) of any feature PR merged in the release.
metrics.source_of_truth: Primary Git commit graph (git log --format=%aI sha^1..sha^2)
metrics.calculation_method: min(commit_timestamps across all feature PR branches in release)

metrics.name: First Pull Request Opened Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Earliest GitHub Pull Request created_at timestamp among feature PRs in the release.

metrics.name: Final Feature Pull Request Merged Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Latest merge commit timestamp on main among all feature PRs in the release.
metrics.source_of_truth: Primary Git commit graph / GitHub REST API pulls/{pr}.merged_at

metrics.name: Release Pull Request Merged Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Merge commit timestamp of the W-REL release PR on main.
metrics.calculation_method: commit timestamp of release merge SHA on main

metrics.name: Annotated Release Tag Published Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Tagger timestamp of the annotated refs/tags/vX.Y.Z object published by the GitHub Actions Release workflow.
metrics.source_of_truth: Git tag object (gh api repos/.../git/tags/<tag_sha>) & GitHub Actions Release run

metrics.name: Live :3102 Production Update & Backup Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: Timestamp of the pre-update SQLite backup (tangleclaw-pre-update-X.Y.Z-*.db) and live :3102 restart readback.
metrics.calculation_method: timestamp encoded in backup filename / server-info startedAt

metrics.name: Observer O-Gate Certification Timestamp
metrics.operational_definition: created_at timestamp of the OBSR-OGATE-*-PASS certification comment on the Release PR.
metrics.source_of_truth: GitHub Issue Comments API on the Release PR

metrics.name: Full Engineering Window (T_eng)
metrics.operational_definition: For a single release: elapsed hours from earliest feature branch commit (t2) to live :3102 deploy (t7). For a multi-version train retrospective: elapsed hours from train authorization (t1 of Leg 1) to final live :3102 deploy (t7 of Final Leg).
metrics.numerator: t7_live_deploy_completed - t2_first_branch_commit (or t7_final - t1_start for train)
metrics.source_of_truth: Primary Git commit timestamps & SQLite pre-update backup timestamps
metrics.validation_rule: Must NEVER substitute inter_release_deploy_cadence_hrs (pipelined tail < 1.0h) for full_engineering_window_hrs.

metrics.name: Inter-Release Deploy Cadence (Pipelined Tail Duration)
metrics.operational_definition: Serial wall-clock time elapsed between Version N-1 live :3102 deploy (t7_{N-1}) and Version N live :3102 deploy (t7_N).
metrics.validation_rule: Must be reported alongside pipeline_overlap_hrs and full_engineering_window_hrs.

metrics.name: Cross-Version Pipeline Overlap Duration (Guardrail 06)
metrics.operational_definition: Duration during which Version N feature branches were actively coded/reviewed/tested in parallel prior to Version N-1 live deployment.
metrics.source_of_truth: Primary Git commit timestamps & SQLite backup timestamps
metrics.validation_rule: full_engineering_window_hrs == round(pipeline_overlap_hrs + inter_release_deploy_cadence_hrs, 2) within rounding tolerance

metrics.name: State C — Internally Verified & Closed Chartered Issues (W_closed)
metrics.operational_definition: Unique chartered GitHub issues resolved by PRs merged in this release, verified by CI + remote Testament pool + Dual-Gate review + live :3102 deploy, and closed on GitHub in the release Milestone.
metrics.numerator: Count of unique chartered issues closed in the release milestone by sprint PRs

metrics.name: State D — Externally Accepted Issues
metrics.operational_definition: Issues independently accepted or signed off by an external customer/user outside the Operator and TangleClaw agent fleet.
metrics.validation_rule: Must be 0 for internal autonomous sprints unless external sign-off receipt is cited.

metrics.name: Tier 2 — Allocated Subscription & Compute Amortization (C_alloc)
metrics.operational_definition: Pro-rata time allocation of the fixed $440/mo TangleClaw subscription + host compute pool at $2.46 per active engineering hour (T_eng).
metrics.source_of_truth: Operator subscription invoices ($500/mo gross, 85% TC share + $15/mo power) & T_eng
metrics.validation_rule: Must be labeled as an allocated subscription estimate, never as a metered per-run cash charge.

metrics.name: Engineering Throughput (Closed Issues / Engineering Hour)
metrics.operational_definition: Primary scale-invariant speed metric: internally verified closed issues divided by the full engineering window (T_eng).
metrics.source_of_truth: GitHub Issues API & Primary Git/Backup timestamps
metrics.validation_rule: Must use full_engineering_window_hrs, never pipelined tail duration.

metrics.name: Unit Allocated Cost ($ / Verified Closed Issue)
metrics.operational_definition: Primary cost-efficiency metric: Tier 2 allocated subscription cost divided by internally verified closed issues.
metrics.source_of_truth: Tier 2 allocated cost & GitHub Issues API
metrics.validation_rule: Equals round(2.46 / throughput_closed_per_eng_hr, 2) within rounding tolerance.

metrics.name: Disclosed Legacy ADE_v1 (Closed Issues / (T_eng * C_alloc))
metrics.operational_definition: Legacy composite index W_closed / (T_eng * C_alloc) = W_closed / (2.46 * T_eng^2), retained for backward continuity with mandatory dimensional disclosure.
metrics.source_of_truth: Derived from W_closed, T_eng, and C_alloc
metrics.validation_rule: Must be computed on full_engineering_window_hrs and accompanied by the 1/T^2 dimensional limitation disclosure.
